name: appletv-tierlist
description: Rank every Apple TV+ show and movie you've watched into a tier list — no backend, no account, just your browser.

scripts.build:js: bun build src/app/seriesPage.ts src/app/moviesPage.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format iife --env='TMDB_*'
scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun run build:js && bun run build:es5 && bun run build:css
scripts.render: bun run build:js && bun run build:es5 && node scripts/agentRender.ts
